intendedUse: Normalize a current Luxembourg L-NNNN postcode, retrieve a rights-cleared real postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and render a translucent area with a clear outline and complete provenance.
recordGrain: one current POST Luxembourg postcode assignment and its truthful postcode surface, with CACLR address membership, address points, endpoints, administration, parcels, buildings and land records kept as separate authorities

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared POST Luxembourg postcode assignment denominator, code-class exceptions and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real LU API/app so a normalized L-NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. POST/CACLR tables, BD-Adresses points, PackUp or Point POST endpoints, PO boxes, organizations, routes, administrative boundaries, parcels, buildings, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves.

officialObservations.finding: The official download area offers current postcode CSV, XML and PDF files in open access. It does not offer postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon data or an explicit AGID reuse/public-serving/redistribution licence.

The semicolon CSV has 9,715 rows and 4,750 distinct valid L-NNNN codes, including 275 leading-zero codes and 523 house/range rows. Columns are locality, street, postcode, parity/range start/range end and an internal POST key. It contains no geometry.

Text extraction identifies edition 27 October 2025, organization/bulk examples and a dedicated PackUp code section. Those classes cannot be presumed areal. PDF text and metadata checks passed; three rendered page images could not be opened by the local image-inspection tool because Windows returned error 206, so no visual-layout claim is made.

The legal notice states that the POST site is protected by copyright. No explicit permission for AGID processing, public serving and redistribution of the current CSV/PDF was found; open access is not treated as a reuse grant.
The old 2018 POST dataset metadata has no specified licence and cannot establish current reuse rights, current completeness or geometry.
The current official CACLR ZIP contains 12 non-geometric files. CODEPT has 4,430 rows and 4,430 distinct codes (4,305 type N and 125 type B). The provider warns that completeness is not guaranteed.
The official file model defines CODEPT and TYPE_CP fields but no geometry fields. It cannot by itself support map areas.

The current GeoJSON has 179,491 features and every geometry is Point. It covers 4,200 distinct postcodes; provider positioning may be manual or calculated from parcel/building centroids and completeness is not guaranteed.

dataQuality.risk: Current POST and ACT assignment/address references exist, but their code denominators differ, all official address geometry is Point, leading-zero endpoint classes are absent from address points, no official postcode boundary release was found, and POST processing/public-serving/redistribution rights remain unresolved.

browserReview.reason: No rights-cleared real LU postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists to exercise. Shared deterministic tests do not promote point data or synthetic geometry.

visualPdfReview.reason: The local image-inspection tool returned Windows error 206 even for shortened image paths; no visual-layout claim is made.

blockerSummary: POST publishes a current postcode assignment reference but no postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release, and its legal notice plus download page do not establish explicit AGID processing, public-serving and redistribution rights. CACLR is a CC0 non-geometric address reference and BD-Adresses is a CC0 Point-only subset with incomplete code coverage. PackUp, Point POST, PO-box, organization, route and other endpoint classes cannot be fabricated into areas. No rights-cleared real LU postcode surface or immutable artifact can be served or rendered.
unblockConditions: Obtain an unrestricted current authoritative postcode-boundary release, or explicit written POST permission for AGID processing, public serving and redistribution together with a complete current assignment denominator and authoritative geometry/derivation basis.
Pin edition/effective date, code classes, exceptions, terms, byte length and SHA-256; reconcile POST, CACLR and any geometry denominator without discarding leading-zero or special codes.

Validate every eligible Polygon/MultiPolygon for closure, coordinate range, topology, LU partition and completeness; do not fill gaps with points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, administration, parcels or buildings.

Publish an approved immutable artifact with no raw addresses, persons, customers, buildings, cadastre or land-right data and pass real LU normalization, loader, API, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
